text: The ISRS Project employs a two-tiered civil works strategy, addressing both simple and complex infrastructure recovery needs. It includes quick-turnaround repairs and functional restoration, as well as structural rehabilitation and retrofitting of severely damaged buildings. The project also emphasizes institutional strengthening for operations and maintenance, updating DepEd’s O&M manual and tools to ensure resilience gains are preserved. Additionally, a dedicated Project Management Office and consultancy support are established for effective oversight and delivery.

metadata.solution_name: Infrastructure for Safer and Resilient Schools (ISRS) Project
